samples.title: Giving back to WaGUAA
samples.reference: HELLO HELLO.  My name is Dean Sheridan. I recently joined the WaGUAA Board. I am the Secretary, I just recently joined the Board this year. I am Class of '82, graduated long ago. Now I feel it's time to give back to WaGUAA. Hope to see you someday soon!

samples.title: ASL movies at the library
samples.reference: Hello! On behalf of Watertown Public Library I am so excited to announce that we are bringing ASL movies into our foreign film collection. They are coded in ASL. If you know any other ASL movies, please let us know. This collection was paid for by a generous grant from Watertown Commission on Disability. ASL rocks!

samples.title: The invention of the TTY
samples.reference: 1964.Two Deaf people invented the TTY.One was a physicist and one was a dentist.They worked together to create the TTY. Cool!

samples.title: Independent learners
samples.reference: The reason why I teach is because I want children to see that they are capable of becoming a critic of their own thinking, so they can become independent learners.

samples.title: An exhibit of Deaf history
samples.reference: Hello, My name is Michael Olson from the Gallaudet University archives. This exhibit includes good history. I’m very proud. Here is 200 years worth of history at ASD and this is a wonderful exhibit. I really like it. I enjoy it very much. Thank you to CHS for making this exhibit possible.
